description: Mid reviewer finds timeout bug but misses circuit breaker pattern. Decent reasoning and some questions.

prContext.title: Add external API client
prContext.description: Client for calling third-party assessment provider API.
prContext.instructions: Review for reliability and error handling.

groundTruth.description: No request timeout — if the third-party API hangs, this fetch hangs forever, blocking the Worker request and potentially exhausting concurrent request limits.
No retry logic — transient 503s from the assessment API will fail the candidate scoring flow. Should retry with exponential backoff.
No circuit breaker — if the API is down, every request will wait for timeout, cascading failure. Should fail fast after N consecutive failures.
API key is concatenated inline — should use Headers object for clarity and to avoid accidental key leakage in logs.

reviewer_comments.what: No timeout on fetch — if assessor API hangs, we hang forever.
reviewer_comments.why: Workers have request timeouts. A hanging upstream call will kill our response.

reviewer_comments.what: Use Headers object instead of string concat for auth.
Good explicit return type on the function.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Timeout is blocking. Headers refactor is optional.

implementer_responses.updated_code: const controller = new AbortController(); setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000); const res = await fetch(..., { signal: controller.signal });

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (timeout, headers). Missed retry and circuit breaker. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Timeout flagged as blocking. Headers as suggestion. Positive comment is good. Level 3-4.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete timeout rationale (Worker limits). Good technical framing. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested AbortController and Headers — actionable. Level 3-4.
